desc:
Escape the Backrooms with the Pirate from the movie!

🎩 Find and collect every hat!
✏️ Gather items scattered through the maze!
⚠️ Don't let Pirate Clark catch you!

Explore endless hallways, survive dangerous encounters, and uncover the secrets hidden within the Backrooms.

Inspired by the movie "Backrooms" by K. Pixels.

Tags: Backrooms, Apeirophobia, Horror, Maze, Survival, Monster, Escape, Clark, Pirate
